description: This file declares functions related to PRACH (Physical Random Access Channel) configuration validation and pattern fitting, used in 5G NR radio communication systems. It includes checks for configuration index validity, zero correlation zone validity, TDD pattern fitting, and sequence index validation.

methods.name: prach_config_index_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given PRACH configuration index is valid for specified frequency range and duplex mode.

methods.name: zero_correlation_zone_is_valid
methods.description: Validates if a PRACH Zero Correlation Zone is valid for given configuration index, frequency range, and duplex mode.

methods.name: prach_fits_in_tdd_pattern
methods.description: Determines if a PRACH configuration index fits within a specified TDD pattern.

methods.name: find_valid_prach_config_index
methods.description: Finds a PRACH configuration index that ensures PRACH falls in a TDD UL slot.

methods.name: nof_ssb_per_ro_and_nof_cb_preambles_per_ssb_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the number of SSB per RACH occasion and contention preambles per SSB are valid.

methods.name: prach_root_sequence_index_is_valid
methods.description: Validates if a PRACH Root Sequence Index is valid for a given PRACH format.
